Description.body: Embeds search once and queries matching ChromaDB collections directly, without using the LLM pipeline. score_min and score_max are inclusive Chroma distance bounds: lower scores are more similar. count is the maximum number of results across all selected collections. collection_use_regex selects collection names and collection_avoid_regex excludes matching names; by default all collections are searched and none are excluded.
Description.footer: Returns documents ordered by ascending distance. Each result contains collection, id, score, and content.
